notes: Checked against OCW's Privacy and Terms of Use page: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and MIT reads NonCommercial as no selling, profiting from or commercialising the materials. Ceder has paid plans, so an app only links to it. MIT's name and logos may be used only as the licence's credit. The same page limits AI models trained on OCW content to non-commercial use, another reason the bank's agents don't read it; nothing from it goes into the bank.
